arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
arguments.explanation: Returns the overall fraud rate across all labelled transactions as a fraction between 0 and 1. It also returns the number of labelled transactions and the number marked as fraud.
assumptions: The rate covers labelled transactions only. Transactions with no fraud label are left out, not counted as legitimate.
It covers the whole data period, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
